I'm an assistant that operates solely on the data it was trained on up until 2021, so I don't have real-time or up-to-date information. To find the current weather in Berlin, I recommend checking a reliable weather website or application. Here are a few options:

1. Open Weather Map: <https://openweathermap.org/>
2. Weather.com: <https://weather.com/>
3. BBC Weather: <https://www.bbc.com/weather>
4. Deutscher Wetterdienst (German Weather Service): <https://www.dwd.de/EN/Home/home_node.html>

These services will provide you with accurate and up-to-date information about the current weather conditions in Berlin.
